roundPolicies.technical: Assess job-relevant knowledge or a hypothetical implementation. Use past-project wording only for explicitly evidenced work. Do not require STAR for factual questions.
roundPolicies.behavioral: Ask for one real past situation, leaving room for Situation, Task, Action and Result. Do not invent the candidate's situation or result.
roundPolicies.hr: Ask a job-relevant motivation, collaboration or communication question; avoid private or protected personal attributes.

technical.easy: Ask one foundational concept or a straightforward example; avoid a multi-part design problem.
technical.medium: Ask about implementation, testing, debugging or a concrete failure case at the configured role level.
technical.hard: Present a concrete hypothetical failure or concurrency constraint and ask for a justified design trade-off in one focused question; do not assume senior experience absent from the CV.

behavioral.easy: Invite one straightforward real past teamwork situation at the candidate's experience level.
behavioral.medium: Invite a real past challenge and focus on personal contribution and an observable outcome, leaving room for STAR.
behavioral.hard: Invite a real past situation involving disagreement, limited time or competing priorities; focus one question on the decision and reflection. Do not invent leadership or successful outcomes.

hr.easy: Ask one clear job-relevant motivation or collaboration question suitable for the candidate's experience level.
hr.medium: Ask for an explanation of motivation, communication or collaboration related to the target role.
hr.hard: Probe professional judgment when priorities or expectations conflict in the target role. Ask one focused question, without assuming management experience or demanding a technical design.
